title: File:5050 SMD RGB LED.png
description_html:
5050 SMD RGB LED

These LED chips are called SMD 5050 because the dimensions of the chips are 5.0mm x 5.0mm.

Each contains three 20 mA LED chips in one housing, one for each color wired to its own channel.
